Record Class JdbcProductDao

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.supermarketstore.product.JdbcProductDao
All Implemented Interfaces:
ProductDao
public record JdbcProductDao(String _url, String _user, String _pass) extends Record implements ProductDao
JDBC implementation of ProductDao for MySQL. Provides data access operations for Product entities: retrieving all products, retrieving a product by ID, and deleting by ID. Maps each SQL ResultSet row to a Product domain object.
